// cwd: Runs from the workspace root on purpose: bun discovers bunfig.toml
relative to its cwd, and bunfig is what maps `.mdx` to the `text`
loader. From any other directory bun falls back to the `file` loader,
which returns each post's file PATH instead of its contents — a string,
so nothing throws and file paths get embedded as blog prose.
// cache: Deliberately uncached. The step's own sqlite DB is already a cache, and
a correctly-grained one: it hashes each item's text and re-embeds only
what moved, so an unchanged corpus finishes in well under a second.
An Nx cache on top would key off file globs, and one input is invisible
to them: project data comes from tmp/*.json (gitignored, outside Nx's
file map) and ultimately the GitHub API. Nx would see 'nothing changed'
and restore a stale related.json whenever project data moved.
